description: Find what is wrong with a workbook: fields and parameters nothing uses (each with a confidence level and the reason), duplicate calculations (identical formulas under different names, and the more dangerous same-name-different-formula case), and performance findings (heavy LODs, nested calculations, deep calculation chains, non-fixed dashboard sizing, live connections, and more). Use it before a cleanup, a migration, or a workbook review. Unused fields are reported with confidence rather than as certainties, because a field can be referenced in ways a file cannot show.

path.description: Absolute (or cwd-relative) path to a local Tableau workbook: .twbx or .twb

name: audit_workbook
title: Audit a workbook for dead weight and performance
